proposal.summary: XWiki Platform (starting in 6.2.4 and 6.3-rc-1) allows injection of arbitrary wiki syntax including Groovy, Python and Velocity script macros via the newThemeName URL parameter combined with additional parameters; patched in versions 13.10.10, 14.9-rc-1, and 14.4.6.
proposal.affected_product: XWiki Platform versions >= 6.2.4 and 6.3-rc-1 through (unspecified older versions); patched in 13.10.10, 14.9-rc-1, 14.4.6
proposal.cwe_quote: it's possible to inject arbitrary wiki syntax including Groovy, Python and Velocity script macros via the `newThemeName` request parameter (URL parameter), in combination with additional parameters.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Confirm exploitability details (whether remote unauthenticated attackers can trigger code execution), capture a PoC request/response demonstrating injection and resulting code execution or impact, and identify minimum affected version range and any required authentication; coordinate disclosure and verify patches.

evidence_quotes.quote: it's possible to inject arbitrary wiki syntax including Groovy, Python and Velocity script macros via the `newThemeName` request parameter (URL parameter), in combination with additional parameters.
This has been patched in the supported versions 13.10.10, 14.9-rc-1, and 14.4.6.
As a workaround, it is possible to edit `FlamingoThemesCode.WebHomeSheet` and manually perform the changes from the patch fixing the issue.
